calls.title: Office Hours | GrowthBook 4.3: Faster Experiments, Deeper Insights
calls.summary: GrowthBook 4.3 introduced significant updates aimed at improving user engagement metrics and feature flag management. Key enhancements included the Daily Participation Metric for tracking user engagement, allowing for the calculation of active days relative to exposure days. Metric slices were improved to enable automatic breakdowns by categories, simplifying data analysis. The introduction of post stratification offers variance reduction for faster experiment results by adjusting subgroup comparisons. Additionally, a redesigned results page provides clearer insights through enhanced drill-down features and filters. Advances in feature flag targeting, such as nested saved groups, enable complex targeting logic, while diagnostics help provide real-time evaluation data for debugging. The focus on user-friendly automation and expanded AI model support was emphasized throughout.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook 4.3, post stratification, metric slices, feature flag diagnostics, variance reduction, daily participation metric
